question: A handball match lasts for a total of _______ minutes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**60**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Handball is also known as team handball 
 
• It is played by passing a ball using their hands with the aim of throwing it into the goal of the other team.
 
• A standard match consists of two periods of 30 minutes and the team that scores more goals wins.
